title: Using passive sensor data to probe associations of social structure with changes in personality: A synthesis of network analysis and machine learning
summary: On 54 workers observed for six weeks, boosted tree models used wearable-derived face-to-face network features to predict within-person changes in self-reported Big Five states. This is a narrow behavioral association/prediction result from a small previously collected cohort and does not establish that social contact causes personality changes.
